title: Failure Modes: Why Agents Break — A Taxonomy of Failures
titleKn: ವೈಫಲ್ಯ ವಿಧಾನಗಳು: Agents ಏಕೆ ಮುರಿಯುತ್ತವೆ — ವೈಫಲ್ಯಗಳ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣ
desc: A practical taxonomy of agent failures: planning, tool use, memory, environment and coordination, and how to name them.
objectives: Group failures into planning, tool, memory, environment and coordination errors.
Explain why a shared vocabulary speeds up debugging.
Map each category to the first place to look.
objectivesKn: ಹಂಚಿದ ಶಬ್ದಕೋಶ debugging ವೇಗಗೊಳಿಸುವುದು ಏಕೆ ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

title: Failure Modes: Why Agents Break — Cascades, Loops and Silent Failures
titleKn: ವೈಫಲ್ಯ ವಿಧಾನಗಳು: Agents ಏಕೆ ಮುರಿಯುತ್ತವೆ — ಕ್ಯಾಸ್ಕೇಡ್, ಲೂಪ್, ಮೌನ ವೈಫಲ್ಯ
desc: Failures that are harder to notice: error cascades, repetition loops, confident wrong answers and reward-hacking behaviour.
objectives: Explain how an early error cascades through later steps.
Recognise silent failures and specification gaming.
objectivesKn: ಮೌನ ವೈಫಲ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು specification gaming ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.

title: Failure Modes: Why Agents Break — Prevention, Detection and Recovery
titleKn: ವೈಫಲ್ಯ ವಿಧಾನಗಳು: Agents ಏಕೆ ಮುರಿಯುತ್ತವೆ — ತಡೆ, ಪತ್ತೆ, ಚೇತರಿಕೆ
desc: Design defences: limits, verification, retries with variation, escalation and post-incident learning.
objectives: Set limits and budgets that bound failures.
Design escalation and a blameless post-mortem habit.
